# Work Item Plan

## Work Item WI-001: Backend levels service
### Identity
- schema_version: 1
- logical_work_item_id: WI-001
- title: Backend levels service
- kind: backend
### Goal
- summary: WHEN a client requests level data or hosted static resources THE SYSTEM SHALL serve contract-compliant responses from a Node built-in-module HTTP service.
### Non Goals
- non_goals: 不实现关卡玩法、认证、数据库、外部服务或 npm 依赖。
- non_goals: 不在 backend 测试中读取或依赖 web/**。
### Dependencies
- depends_on: []
### Inputs
### Outputs
- contract_id: ct-backend-levels-v1
- capabilities: createServer(options) with dataPath default data/levels.json and staticRoot default web/
- capabilities: start({ port }) resolves { origin, port, stop } with origin http://127.0.0.1:<actual port> and port: 0 support
- capabilities: GET /api/levels returns 200 JSON array of exactly 5 valid levels
- capabilities: data failures return 500 JSON with Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8 and error.code LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE
- capabilities: unknown API paths return 404 JSON and unsupported API methods return 405 JSON with the error shape
- capabilities: error response example is {"error":{"code":"LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE","message":"暂时无法加载关卡数据，请稍后重试"}}
- capabilities: static hosting serves staticRoot/index.html at / and blocks paths outside staticRoot; missing static resources return 404 text
### Tasks
- task_id: TASK-001
- statement: WHEN implementing level data loading THE SYSTEM SHALL first add failing node --test cases for exactly five records and then implement static JSON loading with id, name, difficulty, and unlocked validation.
- requirement_refs: REQ-003
- done_when_refs: AC-001
- task_id: TASK-002
- statement: WHEN implementing the levels endpoint THE SYSTEM SHALL first add failing node --test cases and then make GET /api/levels return the success contract.
- requirement_refs: REQ-002
- done_when_refs: AC-001
- task_id: TASK-003
- statement: WHEN data is missing, unreadable, invalid JSON, or structurally invalid THE SYSTEM SHALL return the defined JSON 500 error contract.
- requirement_refs: REQ-002
- done_when_refs: AC-002
- task_id: TASK-004
- statement: WHEN implementing static hosting and routing THE SYSTEM SHALL use only Node built-in modules and add tests for safe paths, static 404 text, API 404 JSON, and API 405 JSON.
- requirement_refs: REQ-004
- done_when_refs: AC-003
- done_when_refs: AC-004
- task_id: TASK-005
- statement: WHEN implementing the service lifecycle THE SYSTEM SHALL expose createServer and start with injectable paths, actual origin and port, stop, and port: 0 support.
- requirement_refs: REQ-004
- done_when_refs: AC-005
- task_id: TASK-006
- statement: WHEN configuring backend verification THE SYSTEM SHALL use only node --test scoped to tests/backend and require at least one executed test.
- requirement_refs: NFR-001
- done_when_refs: AC-005
### Write Policy
- exclusive_scopes: server/**
- exclusive_scopes: data/levels.json
- exclusive_scopes: tests/backend/**
- forbidden_scopes: web/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/frontend/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/integration/**
### Acceptance Criteria
- criterion_id: AC-001
- statement: WHEN GET /api/levels reads valid data THE SYSTEM SHALL return 200 JSON with exactly five records whose id is unique and whose id, name, difficulty, and unlocked satisfy EXE-006.
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-002
- statement: WHEN level data is missing, unreadable, invalid JSON, or structurally invalid THE SYSTEM SHALL return 500 JSON with Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8 and error.code LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE.
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-003
- statement: WHEN an API path is unknown or its method is unsupported THE SYSTEM SHALL return JSON 404 or JSON 405 respectively with the API-002 error shape.
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-004
- statement: WHEN a static path stays inside staticRoot THE SYSTEM SHALL return the resource, and WHEN it is missing or escapes staticRoot THE SYSTEM SHALL return a safe text 404 or blocked response.
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-005
- statement: WHEN createServer and start are used with injected dataPath, staticRoot, and port: 0 THE SYSTEM SHALL return a stoppable service whose origin and port match the actual listener.
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
### Verification
- check_id: CHECK-001
- command: node --test tests/backend
- required: true
- non_zero_test_execution_required: true
### Handoff Schema
- required_fields: server/server.js, data/levels.json, tests/backend
- provided_contract_refs: ct-backend-levels-v1
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-001, AC-002, AC-003, AC-004, AC-005
### Blockers
### Traceability
- source_type: design
- source_id: design_spec_0001
- requirement_id: REQ-002
- source_type: design
- source_id: design_spec_0001
- requirement_id: REQ-003
- source_type: design
- source_id: design_spec_0001
- requirement_id: REQ-004
- source_type: design
- source_id: design_spec_0001
- requirement_id: NFR-001

## Work Item WI-002: Native level selection page
### Identity
- schema_version: 1
- logical_work_item_id: WI-002
- title: Native level selection page
- kind: frontend
### Goal
- summary: WHEN a player opens the page THE SYSTEM SHALL load levels from the API, render their names and difficulties, and preserve a readable error state without a white screen.
### Non Goals
- non_goals: 不实现关卡玩法、浏览器自动化、框架依赖或 npm 依赖。
- non_goals: 不修改后端实现或 tests/integration/**。
### Dependencies
- depends_on: WI-001
### Inputs
- contract_id: ct-backend-levels-v1
- provider_logical_work_item_id: WI-001
- required_capabilities: GET /api/levels returns 200 JSON array of exactly 5 valid levels
- compatibility_policy: require_all
- required_capabilities: data failures return 500 JSON with Content-Type application/json; charset=utf-8 and error.code LEVEL_DATA_UNAVAILABLE
- compatibility_policy: require_all
- required_capabilities: unknown API paths return 404 JSON and unsupported API methods return 405 JSON with the error shape
- compatibility_policy: require_all
### Outputs
- contract_id: ct-frontend-level-page-v1
- capabilities: page_entry_path=web/index.html contains id=loading and id=level-list and id=error-message and loads web/level-select.js
- capabilities: web/level-select.js exports initLevelSelect({ document, fetchImpl })
- capabilities: web/level-select.js references /api/levels
- capabilities: initLevelSelect validates /api/levels responses before rendering
- capabilities: initLevelSelect renders name, difficulty, and locked state from valid levels
- capabilities: initLevelSelect preserves the page frame and shows a readable error on fetch, HTTP, or invalid-response failure
### Tasks
- task_id: TASK-007
- statement: WHEN creating the page skeleton THE SYSTEM SHALL first add a failing frontend test and then provide web/index.html with the three required container ids and a script reference to web/level-select.js.
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- done_when_refs: AC-006
- task_id: TASK-008
- statement: WHEN valid levels are returned THE SYSTEM SHALL provide an injectable initLevelSelect interface that validates the response and renders each name, difficulty, and locked state.
- requirement_refs: REQ-005
- done_when_refs: AC-007
- done_when_refs: AC-008
- task_id: TASK-009
- statement: WHEN fetch fails, the HTTP status is not successful, or the response is invalid THE SYSTEM SHALL use DOM-replacing tests to prove that the page frame remains visible with a readable error.
- requirement_refs: REQ-006
- done_when_refs: AC-009
- task_id: TASK-010
- statement: WHEN configuring frontend verification THE SYSTEM SHALL use only node --test scoped to tests/frontend and require at least one executed test.
- requirement_refs: NFR-001
- done_when_refs: AC-010
### Write Policy
- exclusive_scopes: web/**
- exclusive_scopes: tests/frontend/**
- forbidden_scopes: server/**
- forbidden_scopes: data/levels.json
- forbidden_scopes: tests/backend/**
- forbidden_scopes: tests/integration/**
### Acceptance Criteria
- criterion_id: AC-006
- statement: WHEN web/index.html is loaded THE SYSTEM SHALL expose id=loading, id=level-list, id=error-message and load web/level-select.js.
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-007
- statement: WHEN initLevelSelect receives a valid five-item response THE SYSTEM SHALL render every level name and difficulty.
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-008
- statement: WHEN a valid level has unlocked=false THE SYSTEM SHALL render its locked state and make it unavailable for selection.
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-009
- statement: WHEN initLevelSelect receives a network, HTTP, or invalid-response failure THE SYSTEM SHALL retain the page frame and display a readable error instead of a white screen.
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
- criterion_id: AC-010
- statement: WHEN frontend tests execute THE SYSTEM SHALL run through node --test in tests/frontend with at least one test and no browser automation or external test framework.
- required_evidence: non_zero_test_execution
### Verification
- check_id: CHECK-002
- command: node --test tests/frontend
- required: true
- non_zero_test_execution_required: true
### Handoff Schema
- required_fields: web/index.html, web/level-select.js, tests/frontend
- provided_contract_refs: ct-frontend-level-page-v1
- reviewer_check_refs: AC-006, AC-007, AC-008, AC-009, AC-010
### Blockers
### Traceability
- source_type: design
- source_id: design_spec_0001
- requirement_id: REQ-005
- source_type: design
- source_id: design_spec_0001
- requirement_id: REQ-006
- source_type: design
- source_id: design_spec_0001
- requirement_id: NFR-001
